overview.text: Celo's x402 facilitator presents direct payer-to-merchant settlement in three US-dollar stablecoins and seven local-currency tokens on mainnet, with a separate USDC-only Sepolia environment. Local-token support is not automatic foreign-exchange conversion. Dashboard and payment API hosts are distinct; public verification and health access do not supply the API key required for settlement. Dollar tokens use EIP-3009; local assets use Permit2. Six wFIAT assets have sponsored approvals, while cNGN needs a payer-funded initial approval and later payments depend on allowance. Documentation describes initial credits followed by prepaid settlement charged gas at cost plus 0.3% of payment value, or gas only without a USD price. Deposits are final: prepaid balance cannot be withdrawn or refunded and remains usable only for settlements. Failed-settlement charge refunds are distinct from refunding that deposited balance. Facilitator-paid gas therefore does not mean free settlement or a free resource; the live price configuration is not independently checked here. Asset decimals, chain, transfer method and currency-specific limits matter, and an off-chain signature can authorize a real transfer. Service and custody claims are not an independent settlement audit.
